name: Hormones
description: High school students in Bangkok wrestle with issues such as sex, teen pregnancy, drugs, school violence, family turmoil and more in this Thai drama.

videos.title: Testosterone
videos.overview: It's the start of a new school year. Popular student Kwan becomes class president, while bad boy Win challenges the school rules in a big way.

videos.title: Dopamine
videos.overview: After playing guitar in one of Win's videos, Tar gets the chance to play with See Scape, the most popular rock band at school.

videos.title: Endorphin
videos.overview: Kwan and Win are both chosen to represent their grade in the Teacher's Day ceremony. Sprite's flirtatious ways get her in trouble.

videos.title: Serotonin
videos.overview: Phai loses his friends when he starts dating Sprite. The girls at school gossip about Tar and Toei. Mhog keeps neglecting his girlfriend.

videos.title: Estrogen
videos.overview: Toei walks into her classroom to find the word "slut" scrawled on her desk. Tar wants to reach out to her, but things are still awkward between them.

videos.title: Dopamine
videos.overview: Everyone is gossiping about Toei's run-in with the older girls. Thee and Tar get jealous when Toei starts hanging out with her ex-boyfriend again.

videos.title: Adrenaline
videos.overview: A monk tells Phai that he's heading for a fatal destiny, but he can't stop getting into fights. He's also increasingly jealous of his girlfriend.

videos.title: Progesterone
videos.overview: Although worried at first, Dao's mother ends up being impressed with Din. So much so that she asks Dao to invite him over for dinner.

videos.title: Cortisol
videos.overview: Through Win's manipulations, Kwan finds out that her father has a secret son. Sprite struggles with her "easy" reputation.

videos.title: Testosterone & Estrogen
videos.overview: Kwan gets caught cheating on the chemistry exam, and the news spreads like wildfire -- along with rumors about her parents. Win feels responsible.

videos.title: Oxytocin
videos.overview: Summer break begins. Win takes his frustrations out by sleeping with girls at the club. Kwan meets her father's family. Sprite's baby sister is born.

videos.title: Growth Hormone
videos.overview: The students return to school. See Scape is performing at the Big Mountain music festival and Tar can't hide his excitement. Phu apologizes to Thee.

videos.title: Hormones
videos.overview: The two-day Big Mountain festival begins. Everyone's there, including Dao, who's lied to her mother about where she's going.

videos.title: Rak Krumkrim
videos.overview: The students return from summer break. The kids, teachers and even parents are all talking about a steamy high school TV drama called "Love Struck."

videos.title: Thee
videos.overview: Thee is hurt when he finds out Phu and Toei are together. Pop's younger sister is a big fan of See Scape, and she seems to really like Tar.

videos.title: Toei
videos.overview: Now that he has a new girlfriend, Tar is walking on air. Toei feels uncomfortable when Mr. Pin, the handsome computer teacher, gives her attention.

videos.title: Dao+koi
videos.overview: Win re-enrolls in school, and he has a lot of apologies to make. Dao feels hurt when she sees Din, the boy she dated last year, with another girl.

videos.title: Phu
videos.overview: Phu begs Toei to forgive him for insisting she stop hanging out with Tar. Later, Phu meets a bartender who introduces him to people he can relate to.

videos.title: Win
videos.overview: Win went to New York to better himself, but while there, he struggled to keep his demons at bay -- especially after meeting the hard-partying Jane.

videos.title: Kwan
videos.overview: Although worried, Kwan's parents let her go on a trip to the beach with her friends. Mhog builds up the courage to ask Kwan to be his girlfriend.

videos.title: Mhog
videos.overview: Mhog doesn't know how to feel when his father tells him he has a new female friend. Win continues to struggle with his addiction.

videos.title: Sprite
videos.overview: Someone is impersonating Sprite online and ruining her reputation. Sprite doesn't really care -- until things start to get out of hand.

videos.title: Oil
videos.overview: Unhappy and bored, Oil comes to life when she pretends to be a popular classmate online. She needs to stop, but she doesn't know how.

videos.title: Tar
videos.overview: The school is buzzing with Valentine's Day preparations. Tar cares about his girlfriend, but he still feels a strong connection to Toei.

videos.title: Phai
videos.overview: Phai gets a major wake-up call when a girl he hooked up with tells him she's pregnant.

videos.title: Phatchim
videos.overview: Dao organizes an event where students give each other year-end messages on heart-shaped paper. Phu can't bring himself to give his message to Thee.

videos.title: Growth Hormone
videos.overview: Another school year begins. The girl who introduced Win to drugs in America transfers into the school, and she's shocked by how strict her teacher is.

videos.title: Estrogen
videos.overview: Dao and Koi finally talk things out. Dao wants their close friendship back, but Koi wants more and is hurt that her feelings aren't returned.

videos.title: Adrenaline
videos.overview: Zomzom is upset when her father's friend John brings his daughter and moves in with them. At school, she pretends not to know John's daughter.

videos.title: Serotonin
videos.overview: An older boy at school named Sun has a crush on Mali, and the feeling seems to be mutual. Jane considers becoming a drum major in the school band.

videos.title: Dopamine
videos.overview: Jane joins the band as drum major, but she has trouble with teamwork. Later, she sees Win out at a club for the first time since New York.

videos.title: Cortisol
videos.overview: A rift grows within the school council over the Sports Day budget. Koi builds up the courage to tell her father that she likes girls.

videos.title: Androgen
videos.overview: Jelly promises to return the money she misspent, but Boss doesn't trust her. The school council works deep into the night to prepare for Sports Day.

videos.title: Endorphins
videos.overview: Jane returns to school and immediately gets into an altercation with her teacher. First is always joking around, but things aren't good at home.

videos.title: Testosterone
videos.overview: On the heels of Non's departure, Boss also quits the student council. At the mall, Sun gets a surprising offer from an attractive older woman.

videos.title: Growth Hormone II
videos.overview: With Sun distracted, the other members of See Scape ask Pang to sing for them. Pala is living with HIV, which is why his grandma is so overprotective.

videos.title: Oxytocin
videos.overview: Oil has a seizure at school and gets jealous when she finds out that Pang and First are texting each other. Dao reaffirms her feelings for Koi.

videos.title: Oxytocin II
videos.overview: After what Pala's grandma said to her, Zomzom keeps rejecting Pala's advances. Pang asks Tar if he was behind the rumor about her.

videos.title: Hormones
videos.overview: All of Oil's lies come crashing down around her. With nowhere else to turn, she writes a heart-wrenching, confessional post on Facebook.
